description:
SEEK & JobStreet Jobs API (6 markets)

Job search as JSON for SEEK (Australia, New Zealand) and JobStreet (Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia): title, advertiser, salary text, classification, location and posting date, plus optional full ad text. From $0.80 per 1,000 jobs.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Job scraped: $0.0008; Job details added: $0.0005.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/seek-jobstreet-jobs-api.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

dateRange.description: Only return jobs posted in the last N days. Leave empty for any age. The job board applies this filter server-side; 1, 3, 7, 14 and 31 are the values the sites themselves offer.
dateRange.title: Posted within (days)

includeDetails.description: Open every job ad and add the full description text, salary label and expiry date. One extra request per job and an extra $0.50 per 1,000 jobs ($0.0005 each). Off by default.
includeDetails.title: Include full job ad

market.description: Which job board to search. AU = SEEK Australia (au.seek.com), NZ = SEEK New Zealand (nz.seek.com), MY/SG/PH/ID = JobStreet. Each market only returns jobs in its own country. JobsDB (Hong Kong, Thailand) is not offered: it blocks automated access, including through residential proxies.
market.title: Market

maxJobsPerSearch.description: Cap on delivered jobs for each keyword/location pair (1-1000). Default 100.
maxJobsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search

maxTotalJobs.description: Global cap across every search in one run, the hard cost ceiling (1-10000, default 200). Set it as high as you like, up to 10000; runs stop charging when Actor.maxTotalChargeUsd / ACTOR_MAX_PAID_DATASET_ITEMS is reached.
maxTotalJobs.title: Max total jobs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. SEEK and JobStreet answer direct requests, so no proxy is needed. Set one only if your runs report HTTP 403 errors.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searches.description: Keyword and location pairs. Each pair is one job search on the chosen market. Example: [{"keywords":"data engineer","location":"Melbourne VIC"}]. Location may be a city, a state or region, or left empty for the whole country.

keywords.description: Job title or search terms, for example data engineer or accountant.
keywords.title: Keywords

location.description: City, region or country, for example Melbourne VIC, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore or Hong Kong. Leave empty to search the whole market.
location.title: Location

searches.title: Searches

workType.description: Restrict to one employment type. Leave empty for all. The board's own filter is advisory for some employers: most rows match, a few are classified differently by the advertiser.
workType.title: Work type

name: seek_jobstreet_jobs
